name: @kojo/plugin-ui-sugar-preview
description: Sugar-preview panel (ui.panel contribution): for the current .kojo source, render the two-way mapping (sugar line -> generated ERB line), the transpile diagnostics and the full-width-space warnings; when the snapshot source is available, enrich with the message-block / reachability third direction. Read-only observer: the transpile + replay folding lives in the kojo-sugar plugin's sugar.preview service - this plugin is presentation only.
